The viewpoint produces strong coherent background parallax throughout the clip, natural walking bob, brief head turns, and smooth acceleration and deceleration. The off-camera wearer controls the viewpoint; people visible in the conditioning frame remain separate from the camera.

context: A single continuous recording made by an off-camera person wearing a head-mounted camera. The action description refers to the off-camera wearer's activity; people visible in the conditioning frame are separate people unless the description explicitly states otherwise.

actions.description: {{DESCRIPTION}} This action is performed by the unseen camera wearer and is expressed as first-person viewpoint motion.
